# ZORYQ EVM Testnet — Builder Index

Use this file as the machine-readable entry point for building on ZORYQ.

Network
- Name: ZORYQ EVM Testnet
- Chain ID: 5919065
- Hex: 0x5a5159
- CAIP-2: eip155:5919065
- Native gas token: ZQ, 18 decimals
- RPC: https://zoryq-evm-node-live-production.up.railway.app/rpc
- Explorer: https://zoryq-evm-node-live-production.up.railway.app/explorer
- Faucet: https://zoryq-evm-node-live-production.up.railway.app/faucet

Canonical builder files
- README.md — human quickstart
- network/zoryq-testnet.json — machine-readable network config
- agent/zoryq-agent-context.json — agent operating context and safety rules
- agent/action-manifest.schema.json — schema for safe, previewable ZORYQ Actions
- agent/examples/stake-action.json — example state-changing action manifest
- examples/hello-zoryq/HelloZoryq.sol — minimal deployable Solidity example

Current native contracts
- Swap Lab: 0x8205F34B803eDd79DDCA414F00e12eCdDEdDacbE
- Stake: 0xbB26FaADD1E083C7c0dc0A82Ddb96cC45253Ecb1
- Test token / current zUSD client address: 0xd2121E96C6af936c0496fDB499c1D0613d26c2B9
- Reward Registry: 0xAB1Dd21c529b182191ED84f00A4dF1917652CB10
- Quest Registry: 0x85747F9BdCd758fcfB562c929236CCA6eEB025a9
- Quest Completion Registry: 0xD371eb7863cA000fF5039e2Db613F2094ba46b15

Important status
- ZORYQ is currently a centralized public testing environment.
- Do not describe it as decentralized or production-ready.
- DEX v1 and Lending are under validation and must not be represented as deployed until an on-chain address is verified.
- Never request, collect or expose private keys or seed phrases.
- Any state-changing action must be simulated where possible and require explicit wallet confirmation.
- ZQ, zUSD and Testnet points have no monetary value.

Preferred agent flow
1. Read network config.
2. Read agent context.
3. Identify target contract and ABI.
4. Build a transaction preview.
5. Estimate/simulate gas and call outcome.
6. Show user contract, method, inputs, expected output and warnings.
7. Ask wallet for explicit confirmation.
8. Broadcast only after confirmation.
9. Verify receipt on chain.
10. Surface Explorer link and index verifiable activity.
